body:
Research handoffs currently use static agent guidance and can conflate checkpointed, exported and evaluated work. This adds a research-only Harness² adapter that probes alternative instructions on the same task, composes a selected workflow and retains source-qualified process lessons.

The integration calls upstream recursion, selection, reflection and Library APIs at pinned revision `1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335`, with checks for all 39 upstream Python files. It supports parallel/sequential modes, bounded wall time and call counts, explicit small source bundles, protected-file checks, immutable completed-run evidence and separate rollout workspaces. The editable surface is instructions and skill files; scientific recipes, official metrics and launch admission stay with the existing controller.

`scripts/harness2_workflow.py` provides `plan`, a credential-free `smoke`, and explicitly configured model-backed `refine`. AGENTS, pipeline navigation and development docs link the workflow. Dependencies use a separate Python 3.12/3.13 environment and leave submission dependencies and the main lockfile unchanged.

Validation: **31 passed, 2 skipped** (native Windows lacks symlink creation privileges); Ruff lint/format and diff checks pass. Separate parallel and sequential runs each executed four genuine upstream rollouts, five deterministic editor calls and persistent lesson storage. An independent reviewer found evidence-tampering resume and unknown-executor accounting bugs; both were fixed with regression tests. [Integration CI passed on Ubuntu and Windows](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/actions/runs/39712828512); [repository code quality checks passed](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/actions/runs/39712831987). Windows CI checks out only the integration files to avoid historical artifact paths exceeding Windows filename limits.

Validation uses a deterministic process fixture, not paid model calls or ML training. Model-backed execution and scientific quality gains remain untested. Staging and hash checks are integrity controls, not an OS/network sandbox. Existing stopped experiments remain stopped.

See [setup, commands and limitations](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/tooling/harness2-workflow-20261022/tools/harness2/README.md) and [validation receipt](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/tooling/harness2-workflow-20261022/tools/harness2/VALIDATION.json).
